question: Who was appointed the High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom in June 2020?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Gaitri I Kumar**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaitri Issar Kumar** is a retired Indian Foreign Service officer belonging the **1986 batch. **
 
• Her previous posting was as the **High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom.**
 
• Before that, she worked as** Ambassador to Belgium, the European Union and Luxembourg.** 
 
• She also had stints as the** Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Paris**, and adviser in the Permanent Mission of India in Geneva also at the **Ministry of External Affairs in Delhi.**
 
• **The current **High Commissioner to UK is **Vikram Doraiswami.**
 
• **He assumed the charge **as the High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom on 23 September 2022.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16e4770f5f7af2a3e25eb09dfd5208c394a6855d8b2de4a8acd598ae4ac19108.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr Narinder Batra** has been a very active Office Bearer of **Hockey India** since he took up the post of Treasurer in **2009.**
 
• **Sangita Reddy** is an Indian** businessperson** who serves as a **Joint Managing Director of Apollo Hospitals.**
 
• **Rani Rampal** is an Indian hockey player.​
